verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official CLI that reviews local changes before you push, finds bugs and generates a fix prompt for a coding agent, so the local-diff part of the story is delivered. Nothing in the evidence shows CI-script usage or machine-readable output; the documented output is an agent prompt, not structured data. Missing for 10: documented CI/non-interactive usage, machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output format, exit-code semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
